restaurant.title: Restaurant websites
restaurant.pitch: A thoughtful path from first impression to a table request.
essential: Venue story, gallery and contact details
interactive: Dish reviews, ratings and helpful votes
signature: Scroll from arrival into the dining room
Move the camera to a physical wall menu
Inspect dishes and select suitable tables
restaurant.limit: Original conceptual restaurant. It is not a scan of a client venue. Live reservations, allergy information and operational policies need the restaurant’s approval.
restaurant.production: A real restaurant supplies its menu, authorised photos, dietary information, booking rules and a defined reservation provider.

hotel.title: Hotel and resort websites
hotel.pitch: Help guests understand the stay before they enquire.
interactive: Travel moods and a personal stay planner
signature: Continuous arrival, lobby and corridor route
Room selection leads into a connected suite
Bedroom, living space, bathroom and terrace
hotel.limit: Conceptual resort with licensed furniture. Room photography is illustrative. It is not a scan or a complete digital twin of an operating hotel.
hotel.production: A hotel supplies room types, availability rules, approved imagery and a booking engine. Channel-manager and payment connections are separately scoped.

real-estate.title: Property and architecture websites
real-estate.pitch: Give prospective buyers a useful first view of a home.
interactive: Budget, property type and bedroom filters
signature: Held-mouse room viewing and dollhouse orbit
Ground and upper plans with room navigation
real-estate.limit: Licensed artist-built apartment by FDU_oficial. The showcase differs from fictional listings and is not a surveyed property. Measurements are not survey evidence.
real-estate.production: Actual listings require verified specifications, authorised plans and applicable RERA/state advertising disclosures before publication.

commerce.title: Premium commerce websites
commerce.pitch: Let customers inspect, compare and build a personal selection.
essential: Product pages and concept finish options
Persistent demo bag and delivery arithmetic
interactive: Combined search, category and budget finder
signature: Orbit, zoom and close camera viewpoints
commerce.limit: Independent furniture studies by Eric Chadwick / Wayfair. They are not exact meshes of catalogue products. Other object details retain labelled procedural studies.
commerce.production: A live shop needs an agreed platform, stock ownership, payment provider and merchant disclosures. Shipping, taxes, returns and grievances need real operating policies.

automotive.title: Automotive websites
automotive.pitch: Bring the product details into the customer’s first inspection.
signature: Exterior, rear engine and cockpit views
Part controls, detail cards and finish presets
automotive.limit: One adapted Ferrari 458 mesh. Colour presets are not different car models. The engine assembly is illustrative. Ferrari has not endorsed this independent demo.
automotive.production: A dealership supplies authorised vehicle assets, verified specifications and test-drive policies. Inventory, finance and payment integrations need separate approval.
